annotations.title: Get the Moon Catcher Wire board

description: The current crypto news board: mood, counts, the top stories by market impact, and the AI digest. This is what www.mooncatcherwire.com shows. An answer carries up to 20 (`limit`), from `offset`. `has_more` is true when stories remain, and `next_offset` is where the next page starts.

offset.description: How many of the matching stories to skip, strongest first; with limit, a page of them.
